name: nectar-enviro-ops
description: Nectar Enviro Ops Console — full-stack monorepo (Next.js client + NestJS API)

scripts.dev: concurrently --names "CLIENT,SERVER" --prefix-colors "bgGreen.bold,bgCyan.bold" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run start:dev --prefix server"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
